invalidates: replay before exact and anchor pre-gates

public_gates: M1118 may run exactly three actor-coupling optimizer candidates from the current public-gate base
M1118 must use M1107 exact objective and M1115 combined trajectory retention
M1118 must not use private holdout
M1118 must not use short-family hidden states as training anchors
forbidden_shortcuts: do not change parameters outside actor_mean. and response_context_fusion.0.
do not use short-family hidden states as training anchors
do not add extra seeds or coefficient search after seeing failures

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: tests whether M1115 trajectory retention can preserve exact objective movement before replay
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: driver-candidate pre-replay probe only; no replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, or driver capability claim
stop_condition: stop if all seeds fail exact M1107 no-regression
stop if any candidate changes forbidden parameter groups
stop if trajectory-anchor or target-base-only anchor MSE regresses beyond threshold
fallback_plan: if exact objective cannot move under retention, audit objective-anchor conflict
if target-base retention passes but family-source replay later fails, design family-source materialization
if pre-replay gates pass, design first replay gate rather than promoting

training_stage.stage_objective: small supervised actor-coupling posttrain with exact objective and trajectory retention
admission_evidence: M1115 exports loadable target-base and combined anchors
M1116 specifies exact and anchor pre-replay gates
M1117 opens a new repair branch
next_stage_criteria: combined trajectory anchor MSE is measured
target-base-only trajectory anchor MSE is measured

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1118 can only test preservation of wrong-history replay-calibrated sensitivity and cannot prove anticipatory self-identification.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1118 uses fixed M1107/M1115 snippets and trajectories and adds no new task distribution.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If no candidate passes pre-replay exact and anchor gates, record a negative result and route to conflict audit rather than adding seeds.
allowed_claims: pre-replay repair candidate evidence for level2 proof-retention
no driver capability, promotion, private-holdout, real-vehicle, or paper-level generalization claim

hypothesis: A lower-lr actor-coupling update with M1115 trajectory retention can improve or retain exact M1107 objective while keeping target-base wrong-history trajectory actions close to the current public base.
success_criteria: train_scope is actor_coupling and log_std is frozen
only actor_mean. and response_context_fusion.0. parameters change
M1107 exact objective no-regression is measured
at least one candidate passes exact and anchor pre-replay gates or the failure is classified
no PPO, replay, promotion, private holdout, actor-input change, or short-family hidden-state training anchor is used
failure_criteria: optimizer command fails for all seeds
any candidate changes forbidden parameter groups
all candidates regress exact M1107 objective
all candidates regress trajectory-anchor retention beyond threshold
PPO, replay, promotion, private holdout, actor-input change, or short-family hidden-state training anchor is used
